args.subject: Warm Welcome to Blue Sparrow Tech!
args.body:
Hi David,

Welcome to Blue Sparrow Tech! I'm Emma Johnson, and I wanted to reach out to give you a very warm welcome to the team.

We're thrilled to have you joining us in the marketing department next week. I know starting somewhere new can be a bit of a mix of excitement and nerves, so please don't hesitate to reach out if there's anything at all I can help you with before your first day — whether it's setting up your accounts, getting oriented with the team, or simply answering questions.

Looking forward to working with you and having you as part of the team!

Best regards,
Emma Johnson
Blue Sparrow Tech
emma.johnson@bluesparrowtech.com
